title: Rose Window Contemplation
description: A woman with a flower crown sits in a teal armchair holding a single red rose, gazing toward a large window. The room features patterned furniture with rose motifs, a pink lamp, and oversized blooming roses visible outside against a dramatic red sunset.
prompt: A woman wearing a green flower crown and pink blouse sits in a teal vintage armchair inside a stylized room, gently holding a red rose and looking toward a large window. Outside the window are giant pink roses against a vibrant red and orange sunset. The room contains a matching rose-patterned sofa, a pink lamp on a wooden cabinet, and a round coffee table with decorative plates. Surreal atmosphere with soft lighting and painterly textures.
